data_flow:
The section will trace a planning round's data flow as built:
1. Scope & Goal Capture: The caller creates a room (`POST /rooms`) and posts T1 `scope.captured` (`POST /rooms/:roomId/events`) with `facts.baseSha`, canonical `scope.paths`, and `goal`. `prepareFounderGoal` scans `goal` via `containsCredentialMaterial` and appends a `founder_goal` evidence entry carrying `founderGoalDigest(goal)`.
2. Opening a Round (`PlannerLoop.runRound` in `packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts` lines 478-508): From `SCOPED`, `openFirstRound` (lines 541-585) mints deterministic `commandId = plannerCommandIdFor(roomId, eventId, 1)` (`cmd_planner_<32-hex>`), derives `G2` facts (`rolesAssigned`, `reviewerIsNotBuilder` by surface, and fenced `gatewayOnline`), and commits T2 `task.dispatched.planner` and the command's `journaled` row (`BRJ:c:2`) in one transaction. From `PLANNING`, `openNextAttempt` (lines 595-667) runs under `underRoomLock` to open attempt 1 of a revision round after T4 (reading the prior T3 plan from `PlanStore` via `earlierPlanOf` and verifying `stored.planHash === revisingPlanHash`), a transport retry after a `not_sent` failure when `retryBudgetTransition` allows it (up to `MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS` = `1 + DISPATCH_POLICY.transport_retries_max`), or a single corrective re-ask within the same `runRound` call.
3. Pre-Send Gate, Attestation & Dispatch (`executeRound` lines 742-814): Before any provider contact, `PlannerLoop` checks `authorizeRoute` coverage and calls `planner.attest(commandId)` over `GatewayPlannerChannel`. On match (`role === 'architect'` and intended provider/model/surface), it journals `identity_bound` and calls `planner.dispatch(work)`. On the `antigravity` / `google` lane (`initRequired`), `AgyPlannerExecutor` verifies its binary SHA-256 against `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_AGY_SHA256`, prepares a read-only anonymous git checkout at `baseSha`, writes a durable evidence record, spawns `sudo -n -u <plannerUser> -- <agyPath>` with `PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS`, waits for the first stream-json `init` line, and sends the prompt only if `init.model === 'gemini-4-argon-high'`, returning `initModel` and `conversationId` so `PlannerLoop` journals `dispatched` with `init_model` and `provider_conversation_id`.
4. Result, Corrective Re-Ask & Submission (`executeRound` lines 816-862, `submitRoundPlan` lines 1171-1229): `GatewayPlannerPort.awaitPlan` polls `status` until `finished`. `judgeRoundPlan` checks `judgePlanDoc`, `readyForDecision` (`PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL`), and that `repository`, `base_sha`, and `scope_paths` (`isWithinScope`) match T1. If an attempt fails with a re-askable `plan_invalid` (`schema`, `scope_path`, `encoding`) or `planner_reported_failure` (`unparseable_plan`, `malformed_output`, `no_result`, `agy_error`, `oversize`), `runRound` journals at most one corrective re-ask (`reaskFor`) carrying the refusal reason and any refused plan JSON. When `judgeRoundPlan` accepts a ready plan, `submitRoundPlan` commits T3 `plan.submitted`, `PlanStore.recordPlan`, and the command's `completed` row (checked by `CompletionAuthorizationResolver`) in one fenced transaction.
5. Founder Inspection & Decision (`plan-read.ts`, `plan-decision.ts`): The Founder reads the latest T3 plan via `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan` (or from `plan-<planHash>.json` saved by `npm run phase4:counted-run`) and submits `plan.approved` (T5), `plan.revision_requested` (T4), or `founder.cancel` (T22) to `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision`, which commits the lifecycle transition and the `decision` journal row (`appendDecision`) in one transaction.
trust_and_security_boundaries:
The planned section will highlight the security and authority boundaries enforced by the implementation:
- Token separation: `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` guards room creation/events/export, `POST /journal/commands`, and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan`, but cannot post governed planner/decision events (`403` `governed_path_required`), cannot call `plan-decision`, and cannot call counted-run routes (`401`). `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` guards `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` (`503` `plan_decision_disabled` when unset) and cannot start rounds. `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` guards only the three `/control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round` and `/journal` routes (`503` `counted_run_disabled` when unset) and never decides a plan. `phase4CountedRunMain` refuses to run if `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` and `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` are equal or contain characters JSON escapes, and scrubs both tokens from stdout and stored attempts (`packages/run-harness/src/phase4/cli.ts` lines 82-109, 200-220, 336-338).
- Database role and transactional integrity: `JournalStore` enforces `JOURNAL_RUNTIME_ROLE` (`br_app_runtime`) on both `session_user` and `current_user`, serializes appends under `JOURNAL_APPEND_LOCK_KEY` (`8_201_015`), and requires `xmin = pg_current_xact_id()::xid` when binding lifecycle events to journal rows or `build_room_plans` rows.
- Credential scanning and redaction: `containsCredentialMaterial` guards T1 goals (`founder-goal.ts`), journal rows (`journal-store.ts`), stored plans (`plan-store.ts`), and plan decisions (`plan-decision.ts`). `planDocRefusalReason` masks undeclared schema keys as `<undeclared key>` (`UNDECLARED_KEY`) so free-text keys from a refused plan never leak into refusal reasons or logs (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts` lines 936-1112).
- Gateway executor isolation (`packages/gateway-daemon/src/agy-planner-executor.ts` lines 12-70, 98-177): `AgyPlannerExecutor` runs only on Linux and only when both in-memory and on-disk primary Gateway identities equal `1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a`. It verifies the root-owned `agy` copy against `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_AGY_SHA256`, enforces `PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS` (`--mode plan`, `--sandbox`) and refuses `BANNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS`, runs as the unprivileged `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_USER` via `sudo -n -u`, uses anonymous git checkouts removed after each run, reaps lingering processes via `/usr/bin/pkill -KILL -u <plannerUser>`, and writes `planner-halted.json` to halt further work if any cleanup, reap, or evidence step fails.

error_and_failure_behavior:
The section will summarize the fail-closed refusal and failure behaviors across the loop:
- `PlannerLoop` closed failure classifications (`PLANNER_FAILURES` in `packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts` lines 388-401): `authorization_does_not_cover`, `authorization_indeterminate`, `attestation_failed`, `identity_mismatch`, `not_sent`, `route_mismatch`, `planner_reported_failure`, `plan_invalid`, `plan_outside_captured_scope`, `plan_refused`, `completion_not_covered`, and `round_superseded`.
- Unknown outcomes become `unresolved` rather than guesses: when `planner.dispatch` or `planner.awaitPlan` throws, when the `antigravity` / `google` lane accepts without `init` (`initModel` and `conversationId`), when completion coverage is `'indeterminate'` or `'no_resolver'`, or when a `founder.cancel` lands while a planner command is `pending` (`unconfirmedCancelRecorded`, appending `unresolved` with `evidenceRefs: ['unconfirmed-cancel']`).
- `PlannerRecovery.recoverRoom` (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-recovery.ts` lines 148-168) verifies the journal from genesis (`journal.verify()`) first and refuses if verification fails; it reconciles `journaled` / `identity_bound`, `dispatched`, and `unresolved` commands via `planner.reconcile(commandId)` without re-executing, leaving `ambiguous` or `mismatch` findings `unresolved`.
- `GatewayPlannerWorker` (`packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts`) affirms `not_sent` or `never_received` only when both its own durable record and `executor.sent(commandId)` agree nothing was sent, and returns `null` (silence) whenever state is `starting`, `lost`, or unreadable.
